summary: Seven accused convicted for murder of five persons from the Shukla family; High Court reversed trial court's acquittal citing evidence of long-standing political rivalry and indiscriminate firing; Appellants challenged conviction under Sections 148, 302/149, 307/149 IPC; prosecution established motive through FIR detailing two incidents near Hamirpur market and Parma Pandit's residence; eyewitness accounts and medical evidence corroborated attack sequence
final_judgment: Criminal appeals dismissed; life imprisonment upheld for murder under Section 302/149 IPC; concurrent sentences for Sections 148 and 307/149 upheld; enhancement petition by informant rejected
